council.title: 419, 421, 423 and 425 Woodbine Avenue - Rental Housing Demolition Application - Decision Report - Approval
council.brief: City Council will weigh whether to approve tearing down 11 rentals at 419-425 Woodbine Avenue for an 11-storey building. All 11 would be replaced with tenant help, and the approval carries a $20,000.00 financial condition.
council.stake: Council put off deciding this item.

council.title: 419, 421, 423 and 425 Woodbine Avenue - Official Plan and Zoning By-law Amendment - Decision Report - Approval
topics: official plan amendments, rezoning, zoning bylaws
council.brief: City Council will weigh whether to approve an 11-storey mixed-use building at 419 to 425 Woodbine Avenue with 123 homes, 11 replacement rentals, ground-floor shops, and underground parking.

council.title: Financial Statements and Audit Findings for the Year Ended December 31, 2025 - Agencies
topics: annual reports, audits, boards of management, finance (sc), financial reports
council.brief: This is routine business. The 2025 financial statements and audit findings for City agencies, including the TTC, library and Zoo, are given to the Audit Committee.

council.title: Audit of the Toronto Police Service’s Information Technology Governance: Driving Improved Accountability and Transparency in Achieving Technology Objectives
topics: audits, police services, police services boards
council.brief: This is routine business. City Council receives the Auditor General's audit of the Toronto Police Service's technology leadership, for information. The Police Service Board already adopted the recommendations.

council.title: Mount Dennis Station Protected Major Transit Station Area - Official Plan Amendment - Final Report
council.brief: Approving a transit station area plan for Mount Dennis Station, setting density rules and a target of 160 residents and jobs per hectare. The Minister of Municipal Affairs and Housing gives final approval.

council.title: 3030 Markham Road - Zoning By-law Amendment - Decision Report - Approval
council.brief: City Council can approve a gas station with a store and car wash at 3030 Markham Road, with 10 pumps.

council.title: Report on the Results of Applying Specified Auditing Procedures to Financial Information Other Than Financial Statements for the Year Ended December 31, 2025
topics: accountability, annual reports, audits, financial reports
council.brief: This is routine business. An outside auditor's report on 2025 financial information for the City's accountability officers is presented. No decision is needed.
